subject: Aurum Health - Trial success criteria & hosting options
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@aurumhealth.io>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aurum Health - Trial success criteria & hosting options

Hi Sara —

Great to meet the team earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we scope the POC: 

1) High-level goal (what Aurum needs):
   - Surface structured clinical summaries from intake notes with <4s median latency for interactive use, and <200ms token latency for batch scoring.
   - Maintain PHI controls and auditability during evaluation (masking or VPC)

2) Suggested success criteria (first-pass):
   - Precision/recall on our 50-case prompt set: precision >= 88%, recall >= 85%
   - Median interactive latency <= 4s for a 1K token prompt distribution
   - No PII/PHI exfiltration events during synthetic tests
   - Integration tests: embedding similarity for retrieval use-case >= 0.78 (AUC)

3) POC length & ownership:
   - Phase 1 (trial): 2 weeks (functional/eval) — runs as hosted trial with synthetic/masked data to accelerate start
   - Phase 2 (security gating): parallel security validation for VPC or Dedicated if needed (2–4 weeks)
   - Owners: Jordan (AE) — commercial/coordination; Marissa (CS) — success criteria and evaluation; Ben (Solutions) — infra/provisioning

4) Environment options (quick callouts):
   - Hosted (fastest): Redwood hosted API, lowest start time, supports masked/synthetic data immediately.
   - Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): predictable throughput, shared network, quicker than VPC for infra work but involves capacity commit.
   - VPC (full isolation): required for PHI in production; longer lead time (procure, network configs, KMS), but mirrors production environment.

5) Proposed immediate next steps (this week):
   - You confirm whether Aurum wants to start with masked data on hosted or needs VPC agreement before any test data is uploaded.
   - If VPC is required up front, Ben can provide a provisioning checklist and high-level timeline.
   - I'll share a short "trial outline" (attached) and a proposed kickoff agenda.

Attachments: trial-outline.pdf (2-pg), SOC2 snapshot referenced.

Can we schedule a 30-min internal kickoff Thursday or Friday? I’ll work with Marissa/Ben on ops owners once you confirm the hosting preference.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@aurumhealth.io>

Subject: Re: Aurum Health - Trial success criteria & hosting options

Jordan —

Thanks for the detailed recap. That matches the ask from our clinical team. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Data stance: For the POC we can provide fully synthetic data sets initially, but we will want to run a short set of real, de-identified samples in a controlled way to validate edge cases. Ultimately production will need VPC.
- Security evidence: Can you share a copy of SOC2 Type II summary and any encryption/KMS notes? Our procurement/security folks will need that to allow even a short real-data run.
- Timeline: We’d prefer to start a short hosted trial this week with masked data to validate model behavior. In parallel we’ll start the security intake for a VPC.

I’ve looped Tom (infra) on the thread for the VPC questions — he can provide network and KMS requirements.

Thanks — I think hosted-first + parallel VPC gating is the right approach.

Best,
Sara Patel
Head of Product, Aurum Health
sara.patel@aurumhealth.io

Sara / Tom —

Perfect — thanks for the quick response. Marissa and Ben, adding you both to scope responsibilities and to propose a concrete evaluation plan: 

Proposed concrete plan (short-running, low-friction):
- Week 0 (this week): Hosted trial kickoff using synthetic + a small set of masked real samples (no PHI). Deliverable: baseline metrics (precision/recall, latency) within 5 business days.
- Parallel: Security intake (Tom) — we’ll share SOC2 snapshot and encryption docs; Ben to provide VPC provisioning checklist if Aurum wants to progress to VPC.

- Marissa (CS): define exact eval prompt set and acceptance gating, run quality checks, coordinate clinical SME testing.
- Ben (Solutions/Infra): provide hosted sandbox configuration, estimate Dedicated cost delta, provide VPC checklist + rough ETA.

Tom — Jordan/Sara indicated they’ll start the security intake; Ben and I will follow up once we have the checklist.

Next meetings: propose 30-min kickoff Wed 16:00 PT — Marissa to lead success criteria review.

Jordan

Hi Sara / Jordan / Tom —

Thanks — I review these kinds of POCs with a focus on having a tight acceptance loop and clear owners. Based on Jordan’s notes and Sara’s preference for hosted-first + parallel VPC gating, here’s a recommended, actionable plan with guards so we don’t get blocked: 

Trial plan (actionable):
1) Kickoff (this week): 30-min — align on dataset, attach the evaluation prompt set, and confirm masked vs synthetic samples.
   - Deliverable: agreed eval set (50 canonical cases + 10 edge cases) by EOD Fri 6/25.
2) Hosted run (Days 1–5 after kickoff): run live against masked dataset. Marissa/Clinical SME to run acceptance tests and capture metrics in the attached spreadsheet.
3) Security parallel track (Days 1–14): Ben to run through VPC provisioning checklist with Tom; Redwoods provides SOC2 summary and KMS notes by EOD Mon 6/28.
4) Decision gate (Day 14): review success metrics, if we meet thresholds we discuss a short Dedicated sandbox for throughput stress tests; if security gating requires VPC, we move to calendar the VPC build.

Success criteria (finalized):
- Quality: Precision >= 88% and Recall >= 85% on the agreed 50-case set
- Latency: median interactive <= 4s (1K-token distribution); p95 <= 7s
- Safety: no PII leakage on synthetic+masked runs; any finding requires triage within 24 hours
- Integration: ability to send/receive embeddings via our API and verify similarity scores per the doc

Ownership matrix (quick):
- Eval prompt set & clinical sign-off: Marissa (owner), Sara (approver)
- Hosted sandbox provisioning: Ben (owner)
- VPC security intake & network config: Ben + Tom (co-owners)
- Commercial/terms: Jordan (owner)

Attachments: trial-kickoff-agenda.docx, SOC2 snapshot (previous).

Proposed next step: Jordan — please confirm kickoff time Wed 6/24 16:00 PT or Wed 6/25 16:00 PT (I’m blocking both for now). Once we have that call we’ll finalize the eval set and start the hosted run same day.
